standard-dialogue-all-other-frogs.npc: Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog [prince/princess]!

standard-dialogue-if-the-kiss-the-frog-e.npc: ​The frogs do not need your help right now.
Don't look at me, I'm just a frog. Ribbit! Ribbit!

overhead-dialogue.text: The frog will go through the following list of overhead dialogue when waiting for the player to interact with them during the Kiss the Frog random event

overhead-dialogue.npc: [player name], the frog [prince/princess] desires your attention!
If you kiss [him/her], [player name], [he/she] will turn into a human!
But if you ignore [him/her], [player name], we will turn you into a frog!
That's IT, [player name] you're a frog!
